children: RNS Number : 6717U  Aptitude Software Group PLC  14 September 2026

Pursuant to UK Listing Rule 6.4.9R, the Company announces that Sara Dickinson, Non-Executive Director and Chair of the Audit Committee, has been appointed as Independent Non-Executive Director and Chair of the Audit Committee of the Board of Mulberry Group plc with effect from 9 September 2026.
